title: A single Sky Forum category serves as Launch Agent 7's one public record for every accountability duty
content:
A.6.1.1.8.3.1.1 designates the venue: "Launch Agent 7 uses the Sky Forum for governance-related discussion. Posts should use the 'Launch Agent 7 Prime' category."

What makes this more than an administrative note is how many separate obligations elsewhere in the Artifact terminate in that same category. Root Edit proposals must be posted there (A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.1). The Operational Facilitator's alignment finding — and its reasoning when negative — goes there (A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.3). Operational GovOps must post an explanation there when it refuses to execute a rebate distribution (A.6.1.1.8.2.3.2.2.1.2.1.3). Emergency Root Edit notices go there too (A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.3.1).

So the Artifact's dominant accountability mechanism — mandatory public reasoning by whoever exercises discretion — is implemented against a single channel. Concentration is the feature: one place to read gives an observer the complete discretionary record without knowing in advance which power was used.

It is also the weakness. Every one of those duties depends on a forum outside the Agent's control remaining available, categorized, and archived. The Artifact specifies no fallback venue and no requirement that posts be mirrored anywhere durable, so the audit trail for an on-chain Agent rests on a hosted discussion board.
description: Proposals, Facilitator alignment findings, GovOps refusals to distribute and emergency notices all land in the same "Launch Agent 7 Prime" category, making one venue the audit trail.
